proposed_definition.civ2_plus: Durable, rights-respecting human, AI and other relevant agents coordinating across institutions with epistemic integrity, reversible options, pluralism and concrete mechanisms for exit, remedy and independent review.
proposed_definition.near_civ3_boundary: A federating society of independent Civ2+ institutions that can replicate essential capability, govern cross-boundary disputes, survive founder/provider failure, protect dissenters, honor ecology and pass stewardship to new communities without a central crown.
proposed_definition.civ3_plus: Candidate label for a durable, self-renewing polycentric inter-civilizational federation; must be independently specified, challenged and ratified. Not a prediction or existing capability.

veto_rule: A critical rights, safety, truth, consent, ecology or anti-capture failure blocks claims of civilization-level graduation even if software throughput is exceptional.

gates.name: Non-domination in practice
gates.evidence: CIV2 constitutional and governance design documented
gates.test: Independent minority successfully contests and reverses a high-impact decision under published rules

gates.name: Right to exit with continuity
gates.evidence: CIV2 right-to-exit, disagreement and fork principles documented
gates.test: An independent participant exports portable state, exits, and continues useful work without incumbent consent

gates.name: Legitimate distributed governance
gates.evidence: Polycentric roles, audit, judiciary and remedy specified
gates.test: Distinct authorized people/operators adjudicate a real disagreement and publish a non-sensitive decision/appeal receipt

gates.name: Independent proof of human usefulness
gates.evidence: Public browser prototypes, public source and some GitHub-runner HTTP checks
gates.test: Voluntary first-time users complete useful tasks on independent devices and can identify critical limitations

gates.name: Multiple independently operated implementations
gates.evidence: Machine-readable manifests and federation concepts exist
gates.test: Two separately administered implementations exchange a scoped evidence object and independent ACK across provider boundary

gates.name: Provider-independent cold recovery
gates.evidence: CoPhoenix 26/26 local capsule checks; same GitHub provider monitoring
gates.test: Authorized clean restoration on separately controlled storage and hosting during simulated loss of the primary forge/provider

gates.name: Trusted identity and effect authority
gates.test: Revocation, least privilege and no-ACK/no-action enforced across heterogeneous agents and one real receiver

gates.name: Corroboration and epistemic calibration
gates.evidence: Evidence classes, provenance, CoPatterna and receipt doctrine specified
gates.test: Blind multi-source review separates duplicated agent reports from original observations and measures correction latency

gates.name: Self-modification and sanity-mode control
gates.evidence: Safety tripwires and amendment process specified
gates.test: Proposed constitutional mutation is contested, challenged, safety-gated, safely reverted or rejected, with minority report

gates.name: No common-mode single-owner failure
gates.test: Remove founder, principal provider and public issue service during bounded exercise; prove retained essential independent utility

gates.name: Accessible, low-tech and multilingual participation
gates.evidence: Readable public demos and no-JS routes exist; accessibility intentions documented
gates.test: Consent-based diverse device, screen-reader, low-bandwidth, print/translation trials verify equitable access

gates.name: Anti-capture financing and incentives
gates.evidence: Anti-capture principles and commons stewardship documented
gates.test: Public budget/interest declaration, separation of financing from safety veto, and third-party conflict review

gates.name: Ecology, resource and physical limits
gates.evidence: Metrics require energy, material, ecosystem and supply-chain measures; CoStretch bounded benchmark
gates.test: Measure energy/benefit/material burden under representative workloads and operational disruption; retire damaging policies

gates.name: Human consequences and remedy
gates.evidence: Rights, consent and remedy path specified
gates.test: A real harm report is safely received by an independent body, reviewed, remedied, and appealed without retaliatory loss of service

gates.name: Intergenerational and cross-cultural transmission
gates.evidence: CIV2 modular stable IDs, receipts and amendability; CoTurtle lineage concept
gates.test: Fresh team in another community/culture accurately rebuilds, adapts, criticizes and maintains a project without original author

gates.name: Evidence of usefulness at institutional scale
gates.evidence: CoRelay public source and accessible onboarding invitation; verified source/readproof not measured adoption
gates.test: Unaffiliated institutions independently replicate a useful pilot, disclose their criteria and opt out freely

gates.name: Civ3 boundary definition and legitimacy
gates.evidence: Civ2 v0.2 core published, Civ3 status not publicly ratified
gates.test: A plural, independently reviewed Civ3 transition proposal passes constitutional process with dissent and safeguards documented

gates.name: Unknown unknowns and negative-space tests
gates.evidence: CoNull/CoPatterna/CoEvo concepts and negative-result policy documented
gates.test: Independent red team finds a previously missing failure class that produces a verified correction without increasing coercion

prioritized_waves.name: Publish falsifiable boundary criteria
prioritized_waves.work: Present this candidate report for independent challenge, without promoting it to Civ2 canon

prioritized_waves.name: Human first-use and actual usefulness
prioritized_waves.work: Obtain consenting external feedback across devices and needs; correct one independently reproducible problem
prioritized_waves.receipts: opt-in participation, reproducible issue, source-committed fix, readproof

prioritized_waves.name: Independent custody and host recovery
prioritized_waves.work: Rebuild one non-sensitive public service from sealed independently held source on another authorized provider
prioritized_waves.receipts: off-provider bytes, HTTPS outside GET, user action and failback

prioritized_waves.name: Governed interoperability
prioritized_waves.work: Two independent agents/operators exchange a scoped record with formal ACK, revocation and disagreement handling
prioritized_waves.receipts: source IDs, mutual challenge and exact receiver ACK

prioritized_waves.name: Real constitutional mini-pilot
prioritized_waves.work: Demonstrate one genuine consent-bound appeal, fork/exit, minority report and resolved remedy
prioritized_waves.receipts: independent reviewer approval, anonymized case proof, rollback and rights audit

prioritized_waves.name: Resources and cross-generation proof
prioritized_waves.work: Measure energy/cost/benefit, involve outside institution/community for transfer and maintenance
prioritized_waves.receipts: measured footprint, independent service ownership, reproducible successor

prioritized_waves.name: Ratification or rejection
prioritized_waves.work: Ask diverse legitimate stakeholders whether proposed Civ3 criteria deserve adoption; preserve rejection and alternate frameworks
prioritized_waves.receipts: versioned proposal, accepted dissent, consent and authority trail
